acceptanceCriteria: A spike records which OpenCode 2 channel can surface a fault to the user, and the live edit, patch, beta-context and session.idle behaviour is observed and recorded.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 OpenCode 2 port (adapter 0.3.0) during the rc.2 adapter audit. OpenCode 2 has no plugin log API: console.info and console.warn both land unlabelled in the server log and nowhere in the TUI, so a fault the user must act on is invisible in practice (AHI-022). Explore ctx.session.synthetic and session.hook("prompt") as channels for faults and for user-prompt context. Also unverified live: edit and patch execute.after payloads, the beta context hook, whether session.idle fires, and the stop-recursion guard.
title: Give OpenCode 2 notices a distinguishable or model-visible channel
